title: Emrys and the Horizon
author: Mirabel Ishikawa
blurb: Hazel Ashgrove, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
